text:
Scale: the plate is square and spans about 450 px across, which I take as roughly 26 cm. That gives about 17 px per cm.

Caesar salad: it covers about 190 x 250 px, or roughly 11 x 14 cm. The leaves are loosely piled to about 3 cm high, so I estimate about 90 g of lettuce plus dressing.

Broccoli floret (plain, beside the salad): about 5 x 6 cm, estimated at 45 g.

Tomato-sauce chicken or tofu dish (upper right): about 10 x 9 cm and 2.5 cm thick, estimated at 150 g.

Brown rice and wild rice: a small amount, estimated at 50 g.

Roasted broccoli with vegetables (lower right): about 6 cm across, estimated at 60 g.

Tofu cube and peppers: about 25 g.

Dressing on the salad is already counted in the salad weight, so I list only a small separate amount of 15 g.
